info.description:
This service encapsulates several APIs for campaign validation configuration retrieval. These
    configuration values are relatively static, updated infrequently, so it is recommended to cache the data and refresh
    once per day maximum.
info.title: DataProvider

post.description:
Retrieves the campaign configuration values used for campaign validation for the requested marketplace,
    entityType, and programType context/contexts.

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["advertiser_campaign_edit","advertiser_campaign_view"]

ProgramToEntityToTargetingConfigurations.description:
A nested structure mapping advertiser contexts to targeting clause configuration values. The keys at
this level are program types, two capitalized characters mapping to a specific builder. The valid program types are:
- SB: Sponsored Brands
- SP: Sponsored Products
- SD: Sponsored Display

CountryCode.description: The countryCode for a given country.

getCampaignsValidationConfigsRequestCont.description:
An advertiser context is a combination of specific marketplace, entity, and program type that an
    advertiser belongs to. This context defines the specific configuration values the API is requesting. From this
    input, the API will request all permutations of the input lists. For example, if the country code list includes
    US and UK, entity type list includes seller, and program type includes SP and SB, the API will output the
    configuration values for US seller SP, US seller SB, UK seller SP, and UK seller SB. If the country code list,
    entity type list, and program type lists are null (not defined by the user) will output the configuration values
    for all marketplace, entity type, and program type combinations (a get all request).

countryCodesList.description:
The list of countryCode enums defining the marketplaces whose configuration values are requested.
        When `null` is selected and no value is attributed to this key, all countryCode options are selected.

entityTypesList.description:
The list of entityType enums defining the marketplaces whose configuration values are requested.
        When `null` is selected and no value is attributed to this key, all countryCode options are selected.

programTypesList.description:
The list of programType enums defining the marketplaces whose configuration values are requested.
        When `null` is selected and no value is attributed to this key, all countryCode options are selected.

The targeting group configuration values for a specific advertiser context. This includes bid and

CampaignsConfigurations.description:
The campaign validation configuration values for a specific advertiser context. This includes budget
    and inputted name field configuration values.

maxAdGroupNameLength.description: The maximum allowed length of an ad group name.

minLifetimeBudget.description: The minimum lifetime budget allowed for campaigns.

maxDailyBudget.description: The maximum daily budget allowed for campaigns.

maxCampaignNameLength.description: The maximum allowed length of a campaign name.

minDailyBudget.description: The minimum daily budget allowed for campaigns.

maxLifetimeBudget.description: The maximum lifetime budget allowed for campaigns.

maxPortfolioNameLength.description: The maximum allowed length of a portfolio name.

textFieldValidationRegex.description:
The regex string used to validate the characters and order of characters for campaign names,
        ad group names, and portfolio names.

getCampaignsValidationConfigsResponseCon.description:
The key `campaignsValidationConfigs` is mapped to this API's returned object: a nested structure mapping
country code to program type to entity type to campaign configuration values. The campaign configuration values
correspond to the specified path it resides on. For example, the configuration values at the path `US`, `SB`, `SELLER`
is for the US SB SELLER advertiser context. Only the requested keys will be included in the returned object.

getTargetingClausesValidationConfigsResp.description:
The key `targetingClausesValidationConfigs` is mapped to this API's returned object: a nested structure
mapping country code to program type to entity type to targeting clause configuration values. The targeting clause
configuration values correspond to the specified path it resides on. For example, the configuration values at the path
`US`, `SB`, `SELLER` is for the US SB SELLER advertiser context. Only the requested keys will be included in the
returned object.
